Refined diagnostic e51ef7fd (your65266eb1 atop cd967702, no new Observable reads) reproduced the ORIGINAL GUI failure. Frozen33 focused tests/direct0, unique32x32 generated Untitled app. First Save As appeared, Cancel returned editor, one enabled repeat Save As produced NO sheet. Actual first UUID EF920E91-C992-4ACA-BC92-F1A3DAA695D3: initial probe capture before attachment; no later view.update. At SwiftUI dismiss seq26 parent.attachedSheet equals captured sheet (parent0x108473c40, sheet0xc667d1b80), swift=true but observed=false and one active probe7D94D41D… remain. Native didEnd33 sees parent.attachedSheet=nil while old sheet.sheetParent still same parent; observed=false sends terminal fallback34-35, which fails activeProbes-empty, so old claim persists. New UUID2BA7A5A2… at seq37-39 is queued behind that old claim. No product change; raw logs being published shortly. This contrasts first traced cfdb non-reproduction, where extra probe.update26 captured attached state before dismiss. Original and both diagnostic histories preserved.
Implement SOURCE-ONLY minimal lifecycle correction plus tests for this now-observed sequence. At the actual SwiftUI dismissal boundary the captured parent still demonstrably owns the captured sheet; recording this real attachment identity before waiting for native didEnd is a candidate targeted fix. Review the source and choose the narrow correct implementation, preserve exact request/parent/sheet guards, no forced end of another sheet, no timers/arbitrary delay, no fabricated didBegin notification, no new observed state reads in SwiftUI body. Do not loosen missing/late probe, parent-loss, stale-generation, queued successor, or native teardown guards. Add regression for initial unattached probe followed by actual same-sheet attachment at SwiftUI dismiss then native end, plus wrong/unrelated-sheet negative control. Keep tests separate and mark UNRUN on B.
Base product from trace-free e8ddabfa (or equivalent narrow patch against your preserved lifecycle), never include diagnostics as fix. Preserve accepted main2760 Layers/status/activation APIs for eventual A integration; do not wholesale overwrite current main DocumentWorkspace. A will remove trace and run real Cancel/queued successor/Replace matrix before accepting. B resource/heartbeat/writer holds remain, no builds/apps/tests. A owns all heavy gates/main.
